body: Agent checks the screen twice for a restart: before answering Restarting (agents_on_screen, answers agents_running and stays bound) and again inside type_and_watch right before /exit. Alternative rejected: only the type-time check, which would unbind/release the agent and fail its reads (fail_reads_of) on every 30 s retry for the whole life of a background agent.

Hub retries a restart held by background agents on a timer (UPDATE_RETRY 30 s, retry_at in UpdateAsk, woken via next_deadline), round not counted, until pushed on each answer. Alternative rejected: hold via the subagent registry (running blocks) as a busy signal; not asked, screen detector was the specified design.

Continuation flag lives in registry SessionEntry.restart_interrupted (persisted, skipped when false), set on the leaving Restarting answer when ask.interrupted (Esc written during the press) or Activity::working, cleared when a leaving agent is bound back (keep_agent) or when the Inbound went into the next bound agent queue (send_continuations, before flush_all). Alternative rejected: in-memory set on Slots, lost on a hub restart.

Agent list detector anchors on a row of main alone and takes the contiguous run of rows around it; blocks on a non-main row marked (bullet or filled radio) or with a duration word. Alternative rejected: any bullet row with a timer anywhere on screen, which matches Claude Code tool-call lines.
